basic_profile.bio: I recently joined Reddit to explore and discuss my various interests. I'm a 25-year-old data analyst based in Toronto, Canada, with a deep passion for electronic music, especially Daft Punk. In my free time, I'm either playing Rocket League or getting lost in Star Wars lore. I'm single and tend to browse Reddit mostly during the evenings after work. Although new to the platform, I'm enjoying the mix of humor and insight I find here.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My knowledge stems from a blend of formal education in data analytics and a lifelong interest in tech and music. I completed my degree at a local university, focusing on data science. I spend a lot of time self-teaching through online courses and forums to stay updated with the latest in tech and music trends.
